en.text: Well, look who's here. Another crew that thinks it can make a living down on those planets. I'm Rook, captain of the best prospecting crew in the system.
en.description: A man in his mid-forties, the captain of a rival prospecting crew on an orbital colony station, sizing up a newer crew in the station's bar. Strong, bright baritone with a mocking edge, a confident, loud voice that carries across the room without shouting, quick to laugh at others. Brash and boastful, teasing rather than hostile, a veteran who has been doing this for twenty years and wants everyone to know it. Plain and conversational rather than narrating. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Sieh mal an, wer da ist. Noch eine Crew, die glaubt, da unten auf den Planeten ihr Auskommen zu finden. Ich bin Rook, Kapitän der besten Prospektoren-Crew im System.
